purpose: Record the final unrestricted pre-release audit without changing normative predicates, proof state, runtime behavior, release version or repository history.

findings.title: Official UFC guide inventory is not completeness-explicit
findings.observation: The current UFC normalization page lists five guides, while normativa/source-audit.json and tests/checks/normative_sources.py model four institutional guides. The omitted guide is the UFC guide for scientific journal articles.
findings.required_disposition: N15-B must add an explicit reviewed-out-of-scope classification for the article guide unless an article profile is deliberately added. This must not create a new template requirement by implication.

findings.title: Related UFC deposit acts are not explicitly classified
findings.observation: The current UFC thesis/dissertation receiving page also lists MEC Portaria 1.224/2013, CEPE Resolution 17/2015 and CAPES Portaria 59/2017. They are not active formatting sources in the current registry, but the final audit must record that they were reviewed and classify them as operational/contextual or applicable before release.
findings.required_disposition: N15-B must record reviewed scope explicitly without granting technical authority to operational acts.

findings.title: Source-audit scope still names v2.1.0
findings.observation: normativa/source-audit.json and tests/checks/normative_sources.py still require the scope identifier abntexto-ufc-v2.1.0-current-sources.
findings.required_disposition: N15-B must move the scope identifier to a release-independent/current form or v2.2.0 form without changing source authority or predicates.

findings.title: Human normative map still describes the v2.1.0 release state
findings.observation: docs/NORMAS.md still states that V2.1.0 was audited for release and refers to the prior Gate F state.
findings.required_disposition: N15-B/C must update audit/release-state wording while preserving normative content and locators.

findings.title: Reference PDF bit reproducibility remains unresolved
findings.observation: GitHub issue #18 remains the only open repository issue. The v2.1.0 main/tag reference PDFs differed only in generated PDF metadata/ID. Current deterministic bundle checks do not independently prove that two production reference builds are byte-identical.
findings.required_disposition: N15-B/C must build the production reference path twice under a controlled SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH and compare exact SHA-256 hashes, fixing metadata generation if required.

findings.title: Release surfaces intentionally remain at 2.1.0
findings.observation: Makefile, abntexto-ufc.cls and CTAN-facing documentation still identify the published 2.1.0 release. This is correct before final promotion but must be synchronized atomically for the v2.2.0 release candidate.
findings.required_disposition: N15-C must promote all version-bearing release surfaces together and rerun release metadata/package gates.

findings.title: Reference-validation workflow appears tied to an older branch strategy
findings.observation: .github/workflows/reference-validation.yml watches validation/v2.* pushes and release/v2.* pull requests. No validation/v2.* branch currently exists, while the current release path uses main, exact Gate T and Distribution. Three historical release/v2.2.0-* branches remain.
findings.required_disposition: N15-B or final cleanup must prove whether this workflow still has a unique supported use before retaining or removing it.

findings.title: Remote branch inventory is heavily accumulated
findings.observation: The audit observed 131 remote branches, dominated by completed audit/docs/fix campaigns. No pull request was open when the inventory was taken.
findings.required_disposition: After final v2.2.0 certification/tag, delete branches whose evidence is represented by merged/closed PR and Actions history. Preserve main, 1.x, the current final-audit/release branches until finished, and explicitly reconcile planning/v2.2.0-normative-verification before deletion.

findings.title: Historical release rehearsal branch must not be merged
findings.observation: release/v2.2.0-certification belongs to closed unmerged PR #36, is 104 commits behind main and 10 commits ahead, and represents a historical D5 rehearsal rather than the final release source tree.
findings.required_disposition: Use it only as historical release-rehearsal evidence; derive N15-C fresh from certified main. Delete only during final cleanup after useful differences are reconciled.

findings.title: Historical N13 release branches are stale cleanup candidates
findings.observation: release/v2.2.0-corpus-check and release/v2.2.0-n13-typography-check have the same old N13 campaign diff and are behind current main. N13 is already closed and re-certified on main.
findings.required_disposition: Retain through final release certification, then remove in the physical cleanup pass if no unique evidence remains.

findings.title: tmp-noop branch has no unique content
findings.observation: tmp-noop is 85 commits behind main, ahead_by=0 and has no changed files against its merge base.

findings.title: Planning branch has substantial unique divergent history
findings.observation: planning/v2.2.0-normative-verification is 107 commits behind main and 55 commits ahead, with historical plans/audits and many old implementation deltas.
findings.required_disposition: Before physical deletion, explicitly decide which unique planning/audit documents are already represented by canonical handoff, normativa, tests, PRs and Actions. Move only genuinely useful historical documents to docs/history/; never merge the old code tree wholesale.

passes.observation: README.md does not claim that the project is already the officially published UFC LaTeX template. The current official UFC templates page still marks the Overleaf/LaTeX model as 'Em atualização'.
Reference photographs have explicit CC BY-SA 4.0 provenance; the UFC institutional mark is retained in source but excluded from public/CTAN bundles; proprietary Microsoft fonts are not redistributed.
Stable branches main and 1.x are protected against deletion/non-fast-forward changes, require linear history and squash PRs, and require latex-preflight. Version tags v* are immutable.
evidence: GitHub rulesets Stable branches and Immutable version tags reviewed 2026-08-28

passes.observation: tests/v2-font-poc.sh is not orphaned: it is consumed by the frozen N12 Windows literal-font route. tools/convert-encoding-to-unicode.ps1 is consumed by tools/prepare-windows-fonts.ps1.

The proof-state machinery remains intentionally conservative: green evidence and closed phases do not auto-promote rules to PROVEN. The current baseline has zero unsafe PROVEN entries and is retained unchanged for release auditing.

Distribution #235 passed Gate T prerequisite, release preflight, PDF/A-2b, deterministic bundle construction, Overleaf import proxy, candidate upload and aggregate on the N14-closed main tree. Final D5 must still be repeated after N15-C changes.

audit_limitations.statement: Licensed ABNT full text is not reproduced or inferred beyond available authoritative locators and existing audited evidence. Unavailable text remains unavailable/partial.

A direct network git clone was unavailable in the audit execution environment. Repository-wide claims are therefore grounded in GitHub API inventory, existing repository audits, executable gates and targeted file inspection rather than an unreported local clone scan.
No source-page observation in this audit changes a normative predicate. New or omitted institutional documents must first be classified under precedence and source-status policy in N15-B.

n15_plan.N15-A: Final unrestricted audit and explicit finding ledger.
n15_plan.N15-B: Correct and reconcile release-blocking findings while preserving normative authority boundaries.
n15_plan.N15-C: Create the v2.2.0 release candidate, synchronize version metadata and prove bit reproducibility.
n15_plan.N15-D: Run final exact-head source/validator/preflight/Gate-T/Distribution certification and make the release decision.
n15_plan.post_release_cleanup: After certification/tag, perform physical branch/repository cleanup from the audited cleanup inventory.
